legend: The organizers of a programming contest have decided to present t-shirts to participants. There are six different t-shirts sizes in this problem: S, M, L, XL, XXL, XXXL (sizes are listed in increasing order). The t-shirts are already prepared. For each size from S to XXXL you are given the number of t-shirts of this size.

During the registration, the organizers asked each of the n participants about the t-shirt size he wants. If a participant hesitated between two sizes, he could specify two neighboring sizes — this means that any of these two sizes suits him.
Write a program that will determine whether it is possible to present a t-shirt to each participant of the competition, or not. Of course, each participant should get a t-shirt of proper size:
the size he wanted, if he specified one size;
any of the two neibouring sizes, if he specified two sizes.
If it is possible, the program should find any valid distribution of the t-shirts.
input: The first line of the input contains six non-negative integers — the number of t-shirts of each size. The numbers are given for the sizes S, M, L, XL, XXL, XXXL, respectively. The total number of t-shirts doesn't exceed 100 000.
The second line contains positive integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 100 000) — the number of participants.

The following n lines contain the sizes specified by the participants, one line per participant. The i-th line contains information provided by the i-th participant: single size or two sizes separated by comma (without any spaces). If there are two sizes, the sizes are written in increasing order. It is guaranteed that two sizes separated by comma are neighboring.
output: If it is not possible to present a t-shirt to each participant, print «NO» (without quotes).

Otherwise, print n + 1 lines. In the first line print «YES» (without quotes). In the following n lines print the t-shirt sizes the orginizers should give to participants, one per line. The order of the participants should be the same as in the input.
If there are multiple solutions, print any of them.

legend.ai: 编程竞赛的组织者决定向参赛者赠送 T 恤。本题中有六种不同的 T 恤尺码：S、M、L、XL、XXL、XXXL（尺码按递增顺序列出）。T 恤已经准备完毕。对于从 S 到 XXXL 的每种尺码，给出该尺码 T 恤的数量。
在报名期间，组织者询问了 n 位参赛者中的每一人想要的 T 恤尺码。如果某位参赛者在两个尺码之间犹豫，他可以指定两个相邻的尺码——这意味着这两个尺码中的任意一个都适合他。
编写一个程序，判断是否可以为竞赛的每位参赛者提供一件 T 恤。当然，每位参赛者都应得到合适尺码的 T 恤：
如果他指定了一个尺码，则为他想要的尺码；
如果他指定了两个尺码，则可以选择其中任意一个相邻尺码。
如果可能，程序应找出一种有效的 T 恤分配方案。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含六个非负整数，分别表示 S、M、L、XL、XXL、XXXL 各尺码的 T 恤数量。T 恤总数不超过 100 000。
第二行包含正整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 100 000），表示参与者的数量。
接下来的 n 行包含参与者指定的尺码，每位参与者占一行。第 i 行包含第 i 位参与者提供的信息：一个尺码，或由逗号分隔的两个尺码（不含空格）。如果有两个尺码，则尺码按递增顺序给出。保证由逗号分隔的两个尺码相邻。

output.ai: 如果无法为每位参与者分配一件 T 恤，则输出 «NO»（不含引号）。
否则，输出 n + 1 行。第一行输出「YES」（不含引号）。接下来的 n 行中，每行输出组织者应分发给参赛者的 T 恤尺码。参赛者的顺序应与输入中的顺序相同。
如果有多个解，输出其中任意一个即可。
